Name: Truvizy Threat Intelligence
Author: Truvizy - support@truvizy.app
Description: The Truvizy Threat Intelligence solution brings scam and phishing indicators confirmed by the [Truvizy](https://truvizy.app) detection network into Microsoft Sentinel through the built-in TAXII 2.1 data connector. Indicators are curated for safe blocking: only high-confidence indicators are published, shared platforms (such as youtube.com) are never listed at the domain level, and indicators expire automatically when they stop being relevant. The solution includes analytics rules that match Truvizy indicators against proxy and DNS telemetry, plus a hunting query for feed overview. Feed credentials are issued by the Truvizy team during onboarding.
